subject: WRITE statement
notes: kb/Work PB1191: the strip is keyed on the three things GR21 names. A FD whose RECORD clause has the DEPENDING phrase is untouched (GR22); the alphanumeric space is the space character only (U+00A0 survives); and a WRITE or REWRITE carries record-name-1's own category (FileModel.IsNationalRecord, rendered as nationalRecord: true), so an FD with a national and an alphanumeric record description writes each with its own space, never the area's flag.
